_comment: PARTNER CONTENT PACKAGE. Everything referring to real people, the show's identity, and partner-specific rules lives here so it can be reviewed and replaced as a unit. Nothing in this file is approved yet. Real people are represented by name and role only: figures are generic placeholder looks, NOT likenesses. No logos, recordings, or music are used. Panel guests other than the host and Redban are fictional.

lines.bucket_intro: Tony reaches into the bucket. Redban cues up a drop. The room gets loud. Names start getting pulled.
lines.called_up: Tony squints at the slip. "{stage}! Get up here!" The crowd turns to look at you. Somebody yells, "Look at {him}, {he}'s shaking!" You have one minute.
lines.not_called: Tony pulls the last name of the night. It isn't yours. The show goes on, and you watch every set like homework.

low: The panel exchanges a long look. Redban plays a sad trombone.
Somebody on the panel is quietly writing nothing down.
mid: The panel nods. A couple of real laughs in there.
Tony leans into the mic: 'Okay. Okay. There's something there.'
high: The panel is laughing. Tony slaps the desk.
Big applause. Redban hits an air horn and the band joins in.

lines.redban_invite: Redban leans into his mic from the sound desk: 'You should come do The Secret Show on Thursday.'
lines.golden_ticket: Tony holds up a golden ticket. Redban hits every drop he has. The room explodes.
lines.joke_book: Tony hands you a joke book. 'Fill this up.'
lines.opening_offer: One of tonight's guest comics catches you backstage: 'I've got a weekend at the Lantern. Want to open?'
lines.regular_intro: No bucket for you tonight. Tony reads the lineup: "...and one of our regulars, {stage}!" Redban hits your walk-on drop. Remember: the panel expects new material.
lines.panel_intro:
Tony introduces you: "Our guest tonight came up through this very bucket. Give it up for {stage}!" Redban plays you on.

You take your seat at the desk, right next to Tony. Tonight you're the one judging.

_guest_pool_note: Fictional placeholder guest comedians. Real guest comedians are not modelled yet.
